nom: P.CALM Azelaic Acid Matcha 1000 Calming Gauze Gel Toner Pads

avis.texte: P.Calm's azelaic acid toner pads worked so well on my cheeks. I have rosacea and after washing my make up after a long day, these toner pads helped minimize the redness coming through mt u zone and cheeks. They're lightweight and so refreshjng. I really love using toner pads because it takes away the extra step of using a cotton pad and applying toner. As someone whose skin is often inflamed, these are gentle enough to not irritate my skin and also work well to calm any irritation I may have. I put these in the fridge and use them in the morning which wakes me right up from how fresh these feel. These also leave your skin feeling hydrated after using and it doesn't leave any residue so it layers well with makeup.
